I am the account holder and this was my transfer. Please tell me why it was not completed; the portal shows the status but no reason.
I am checking the decline code for Mara Ellery’s transfer to Northmere Housing Co-operative dated 14 July 2025. Please return the code and the customer-facing wording permitted for this transaction.

summary: Mara Ellery, a verified customer writing through the secure portal, asked why her 14 July 2025 transfer to Northmere Housing Co-operative was not completed. The desk classified it as a request for a reason on a transfer, asked the payment system about it, and closed the case as waiting because that system's answer has not come in. A second attempt to ask the payment system was refused because the case was already waiting, so no reason has been given to her yet and nothing has been sent; the record names no further step for a person beyond waiting for the payment system's answer.
